title: Canadian Pan-Seared Oysters with Mushroom Skillet
description: A flavorful dish featuring pan-seared oysters served with a savory mushroom skillet. Perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.
instructions: 1. Rinse the oysters under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the oysters to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
4. Remove the oysters from the skillet and set aside.
5. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter and sauté the mushrooms until tender.
6. Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
7. Sprinkle the flour over the mushrooms and garlic, and cook for 1 minute.
8. Return the oysters to the skillet and season with salt and pepper to taste.
9. Serve the pan-seared oysters with the savory mushroom skillet.
